ui.ctaNote: One inbox free, forever. No card required.

steps.p: In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, open Customize, then Connectors. Click + Add, then Add custom connector.
Name it MCPEmails, paste https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp as the URL and click Continue. Keep the detected sign-in settings and click Add.

steps.h: Sign in and turn it on
steps.p: Sign in with MCPEmails and approve the access you want Claude to have. In a chat, click +, choose Connectors and turn MCPEmails on. Then ask Claude about your mail.

claude.note: Claude's Free plan allows one custom connector; Pro and Max allow as many as you need. On Team and Enterprise, an Owner adds MCPEmails under Organization settings, Connectors, and members click Connect.

steps.p: In ChatGPT, open Plugins, find Any Mailbox in the plugin directory and click Install plugin, then Connect. Any Mailbox is the MCPEmails plugin.
Sign in with the MCPEmails account you connected the mailbox to, and choose which mailboxes ChatGPT can reach.
Type @ in a chat and pick Any Mailbox, then ask about your mail. Pick it again when a follow-up needs your mail.

chatgpt.note: If Any Mailbox cannot be installed in your account, add MCPEmails as a custom MCP server on chatgpt.com instead: Plugins, Personal, Add, Add custom MCP server, paste https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp and choose OAuth. OpenAI lists Business and Enterprise/Edu for this, with read-only access on Pro.

prep.p: In Yahoo Account Security, under External connections, create an app password and copy it. If the option is missing, turn on two-step verification first. Your normal Yahoo password will not work.
Sign up at mcpemails.com, no card needed. Under Dashboard, Inboxes, add your full Yahoo address and the app password.
At account.apple.com, open Sign-In and Security, then App-Specific Passwords, and create one. Two-factor authentication must be on. Your Apple Account password will not work.
Sign up at mcpemails.com, no card needed. Under Dashboard, Inboxes, add your iCloud address and the app-specific password.
You need your address, your password (or an app password if your provider requires one) and your IMAP and SMTP hosts, which your provider or hosting panel lists.

Sign up at mcpemails.com, no card needed. Under Dashboard, Inboxes, choose IMAP / SMTP and type your address: MCPEmails fills in hosts and ports for the providers it recognises. Add the password and connect.

meta.title: Connect Yahoo Mail to Claude
meta.description: Connect Yahoo Mail to Claude in five steps: a Yahoo app password, MCPEmails, and a custom connector in claude.ai or Claude Desktop. One inbox free.

claude.answer: Claude has no built-in Yahoo Mail connector. Connect your Yahoo inbox to MCPEmails with a Yahoo app password, then add MCPEmails to Claude as a custom connector with the URL https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp. Claude can then read, search, draft, send and organize your Yahoo mail.

faq.q: Does Claude have a Yahoo Mail connector?
faq.a: No. Claude's built-in connectors cover Gmail and Microsoft 365, not Yahoo. A custom connector pointing at an MCP server such as MCPEmails is how Claude reaches a Yahoo inbox.

faq.q: Why is my Yahoo password rejected?
faq.a: Yahoo does not accept your account password from outside apps. Create an app password under External connections on the Yahoo Account Security page and use that. If the option is missing, turn on two-step verification first.

faq.q: Does it work in Claude Desktop and on the free Claude plan?
faq.a: Yes. claude.ai and Claude Desktop share the same connectors, so adding MCPEmails in one makes it available in the other. Claude's Free plan allows one custom connector.

faq.q: Is my Yahoo mail stored?
faq.a: No. Messages are fetched live from Yahoo for each request. The app password is stored encrypted, and deleting it in Yahoo Account Security ends access at once.

faq.q: Can I use the same Yahoo inbox in Claude?

meta.title: Connect iCloud Mail to Claude
meta.description: Connect iCloud Mail to Claude in five steps: an Apple app-specific password, MCPEmails, and a custom connector in claude.ai or Claude Desktop. No Mac needed.

claude.answer: Claude has no built-in iCloud connector and Apple offers no OAuth for iCloud Mail. Connect your iCloud inbox to MCPEmails with an Apple app-specific password, then add MCPEmails to Claude as a custom connector with the URL https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp. Claude can then read, search, draft, send and organize the mail you see in Apple Mail.

faq.q: Does Claude work with iCloud Mail?
faq.a: Yes, through a custom connector. Claude's built-in connectors do not include iCloud. MCPEmails connects the mailbox over IMAP with an Apple app-specific password and gives Claude read, search, draft, send, schedule and organize access.

faq.q: Does it work with an iCloud+ custom domain address?
faq.a: Yes. A custom domain address is an alias on your iCloud account, so its mail arrives in the same inbox. Sign in with your iCloud account and the app-specific password. To send from the custom address, add it as a Send As address and confirm the code emailed to it.

faq.q: Does my Mac need to be on?
faq.a: No. MCPEmails is hosted and connects to Apple's mail servers directly, so Claude reaches your iCloud mail from any device. Folders kept only On My Mac are not included.

faq.q: Can Claude use iCloud and my other inboxes together?
faq.a: Yes. One MCPEmails connector holds iCloud next to Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo or a work IMAP mailbox. The free plan connects one inbox; Personal connects three and Pro up to ten.

meta.title: Connect iCloud Mail to ChatGPT
meta.description: Use iCloud Mail in ChatGPT through Any Mailbox, the MCPEmails plugin, with custom domain addresses and your other inboxes in the same plugin. One inbox free.

chatgpt.answer: Connect your iCloud inbox to MCPEmails with an Apple app-specific password, then install Any Mailbox, the MCPEmails plugin in the ChatGPT plugin directory, and sign in. ChatGPT can then read, search, draft, send and organize your iCloud mail, including mail to an iCloud+ custom domain, and the same inbox works in Claude.

faq.q: ChatGPT has its own iCloud plugin. When does MCPEmails fit?
faq.a: OpenAI's iCloud Mail plugin connects an iCloud mailbox to ChatGPT. MCPEmails fits when you also use Claude or another MCP client, use an iCloud+ custom domain address, or want iCloud next to Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo or work inboxes behind one plugin. It also saves drafts to your iCloud Drafts folder, schedules sends, and moves, flags and archives mail.

faq.q: Does it work with an iCloud+ custom domain address?
faq.a: Yes. A custom domain address is an alias on your iCloud account, so its mail arrives in the same inbox. To send from it, add it as a Send As address in MCPEmails and confirm the code emailed to it.

faq.q: Why is my Apple password rejected?
faq.a: iCloud never accepts the Apple Account password from a mail app. Create an app-specific password at account.apple.com under Sign-In and Security. That option appears only when two-factor authentication is on.

faq.q: Is my iCloud mail stored?
faq.a: No. Messages are fetched live from Apple for each request. The app-specific password is stored encrypted, and revoking it in your Apple Account ends access at once.

meta.title: Connect Any IMAP Mailbox to Claude
meta.description: Connect any IMAP mailbox to Claude: add it to MCPEmails with your host and password, then add a custom connector in claude.ai or Claude Desktop. One inbox free.

claude.h1: Connect any IMAP mailbox to Claude
claude.answer: Claude has no IMAP client of its own. Connect your mailbox to MCPEmails with your address, IMAP and SMTP hosts and password, then add MCPEmails to Claude as a custom connector with the URL https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp. Claude can then read, search, draft, send and organize that mail, whoever hosts it.

faq.q: Does Claude support IMAP?
faq.a: Not directly. Claude reaches mail through connectors, and its built-in ones cover Gmail and Microsoft 365. A custom connector pointing at MCPEmails gives Claude any mailbox that speaks IMAP and SMTP on the standard ports.

faq.q: Which ports does it use?
faq.a: IMAP on 993 or 143 and SMTP on 465 or 587. MCPEmails tries the standard transport and falls back to the other one on its own.

faq.q: Can I connect several company mailboxes?
faq.a: Yes. One connector holds every mailbox you add, such as info@, sales@ and your own. The free plan connects one inbox; Personal connects three and Pro up to ten.

faq.q: Is my mail stored?
faq.a: No. Messages are fetched live from your server for each request. The password is stored encrypted, and changing it at your provider ends access.
